title: 326m Up a Cliff in 66 Seconds — Would You Ride It? | China Travel Expert
description:
326 metres up a sheer cliff in about 66 seconds — or climb the stairs for hours. Which do you pick?

In Zhangjiajie's "Avatar" sandstone mountains, the Bailong Elevator runs up the cliff face in glass cars. Guinness recognised it in 2015 as the world's tallest outdoor lift, around 326 m. A one-way ride is about 72 yuan (roughly US$10) in peak season and takes a little over a minute — versus a long stair climb to the same clifftop viewpoints.

🧭 Expert Tip: Ride up and walk down — you get the big reveal fast, then the quieter trail views, and you dodge the worst elevator queue.
